title: Product of Array Except Self
summary: For every position, compute the product of all the other numbers, without using division.

tests.explain: Every product except the one that skips the 0 includes the 0. Skipping index 1 gives 3 × 2 = 6.
Two zeros: every product includes at least one of them.

hints: The product of everything except nums[i] is (product of everything left of i) × (product of everything right of i).
Those are prefix and suffix products, the multiplicative version of prefix sums. Build the left products in one pass from the left.
Then walk from the right with a single running variable for the right product, multiplying it into the answer. That keeps extra space at O(1) besides the output.

complexity.space: O(1) extra besides the output array
